decode_settings.note: language is pinned to ja for every system; no system is allowed to language-detect, and no .en checkpoint is eligible

metrics.justification: Japanese is written without spaces between words, so word-level tokenization is not well defined and WER would measure the segmenter as much as the model. The Hugging Face Audio Course, Chapter 5 ('Evaluation metrics for ASR'), states this directly.
metrics.quote: Certain languages, such as Mandarin and Japanese, have no notion of 'words', and so the WER is meaningless. Here, we revert to using the CER.
metrics.character_f1_rationale: Reported alongside CER because CER is an unbounded error rate that merges insertions, deletions and substitutions into one number. Character F1 is bounded in [0,1] and charges hallucinated text to precision rather than inflating a single rate, so the two together separate 'missed the lyric' from 'invented extra text'.

systems.name: faster-whisper-base
systems.note: also used by lyrics_asr.ja_align to estimate the per-song scalar time offset

systems.name: faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo
systems.family: attention encoder-decoder (multilingual Whisper large-v3-turbo, CTranslate2 conversion)

systems.name: kotoba-whisper-v2.0
systems.family: distilled Whisper encoder-decoder trained for Japanese only
systems.note: Japanese-specialised already-trained checkpoint; distilled from whisper-large-v3 on the ReazonSpeech Japanese corpus. Teacher card: https://huggingface.co/kotoba-tech/kotoba-whisper-v2.0

systems.name: anime-whisper
systems.family: distilled Whisper encoder-decoder trained for Japanese only
systems.note: Japanese-specialised already-trained checkpoint; kotoba-whisper-v2.0 fine-tuned further on ~5,300 h of expressive Japanese speech. Ships only in transformers format, so it runs in the Colab/GPU path (colab_handoff/run_colab.py), not the CTranslate2-only local runner. The model card warns against initial prompts, so none is used.

systems.name: whisper-small-lora-ja
systems.family: multilingual Whisper + LoRA adapter fine-tuned on this corpus

training.selection: lowest validation CER, evaluated after every epoch

systems.note: The project's own modelling contribution. Not expected to top the table: 2.7 h over 11 singers cannot out-train a model distilled on thousands of hours of Japanese. The informative comparison is against faster-whisper-small, which shares its base checkpoint and size. Runs in colab_handoff/run_colab.py --stage finetune.

excluded_systems.exclusion_reason: The model card declares exactly 25 European languages (bg, hr, cs, da, nl, en, et, fi, fr, de, el, hu, it, lv, lt, mt, pl, pt, ro, sk, sl, es, sv, ru, uk) and never mentions Japanese. Scoring it on this Japanese-only corpus would require decoding under a language it does not support, which the project's rules forbid.
